dp.basis: a plate exchanger at its design flow; write dp=0 for an ideal block

dp2.basis: the secondary side, on the same basis as dp

leakage.basis: Belimo's bypass at leakage class I; a rotary body is under 0.05 %

margin.basis: size to the computed duty, with no spare

diagnostics.message: The circuit closes on itself, so components are ordered by a depth-first walk from the pressure datum.
